serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Melissa was right, she’s totally fooled by the chatbot.
Should I tell her the truth?
Better not. There’s no point in hurting her, even if she didn’t like Melissa that much.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
You: No, it isn’t a big shock. I just felt a little down, that’s all.
Bot: You shouldn’t be sad! She found a better job, so her quality of life should improve. She moved quite far away, but we could still pay her a visit if it’s such a big deal for you.
Unfortunately that won’t be possible…
You: No, I’m fine.
Bot: I’m sure she will find new friends. Thanks to you, she opened up a little.
You: Right…{{wi}} You are right…
You: Let’s change the topic, alright?
Bot: Sure!
